originality.rationale: Substantive comparison, not timestamp/failed-search: Mitchell arXiv:1907.06537 gives globally convergent Kreiss-constant approximation algorithms for stable matrices, not certified finite-horizon Mmax(t) peak intervals or cross-n ratio for T_n=-I+2N at n=8,10,12,14,16. Embree arXiv:2312.15022 gives Lyapunov-inner-product extension of Elman GMRES bound (bounding program trading range location vs distortion), no concrete certified peaks for this sequence. Matalon & Spillane arXiv:2506.17193 proves simultaneous GMRES curve prescription as pure existence theorem, no concrete peak values. Pseudospectra Gateway Orr-Sommerfeld page (R=5772,N=99-100, Reddy-Schmid-Henningson) publishes pseudospectra plots/MATLAB code only, no two-sided Mmax intervals or peak ratio. No source records identical numeric enclosures; general Kreiss/Elman/GMRES theorems do not mechanically imply the 4%-width numeric endpoints, which require in-run time-domain exponential-action optimization plus exclusion certificates.

Values not known or mechanically implied (require t-optimization + SVD; independent numpy maxima confirm non-obvious ~3.6x per +2 dims, not closed-form). Reusable precise fact: checkable peak-transient data anchoring rigorous-bound comparisons and growth-law fits. Honestly scoped: Lyapunov sqrt(kappa(P)) tally marked computed comparison, growth exponent marked conjecture, no claim of complete census or asymptotic law. Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration. Narrow exact datum explicitly eligible under value standard.
